en.rr.hint.route: Watch the way to the star.
en.rr.move.instruction: Tap an arrow. Take the robot to the star.
en.rr.move.correct: Yes. The robot is at the star.
en.rr.move.incorrect: The robot has run out of power. Back to the start.
en.rr.move.hint.reveal: Tap the arrow I point to.
en.rr.steps.instruction: Put the arrows in order. Then press go.
en.rr.steps.correct: Yes. Your steps took the robot to the star.
en.rr.steps.incorrect: Not at the star yet. Change a step and try again.
en.rr.steps.hint.reveal: Here are all the steps. Put them in.
en.rr.repeat.instruction: The star is far away. Make your steps. Then tap the again button.
en.rr.repeat.correct: Yes. The same steps, again and again.
en.rr.mend.instruction: One step is wrong. Watch the robot. Then change that step.
en.rr.mend.correct: Yes. You found the wrong step and changed it.
en.rr.mend.incorrect: Still not at the star. Look for the step that went wrong.
en.rr.mend.hint.model: Watch again. Where does it go wrong?
en.rr.mend.hint.reveal: This is the step to change.

skills.title: Know what each arrow does
skills.objective: Takes the robot to a goal one command at a time: knows that forward moves it one square the way it is facing, and that a turn changes the way it faces without moving it.

skills.title: Plan two or three steps
skills.objective: Puts two or three commands in order before any of them is carried out, so that the robot reaches the goal when the program is run.

skills.title: Make steps happen again
skills.objective: Uses "do it again" so that a short program takes the robot a long way, on journeys that are too long for the program without it.

skills.title: Find and mend a wrong step
skills.objective: Watches a program go wrong, finds the one step that sends the robot the wrong way, and changes that step so that the robot arrives.

lessons.title: One arrow, one move
lessons.summary: Each tap of an arrow is carried out at once, so your child sees what it does: forward moves the robot one square the way it is facing, a turn only turns it. The robot has power for a few moves more than the journey needs.

lessons.title: Two and three steps in order
lessons.summary: Now the steps are put in a row first and run afterwards. Your child plans two or three commands, presses go, and watches the robot carry them out one by one. A plan that does not arrive is changed and run again.

lessons.title: Do it again
lessons.summary: The star is too far for the few steps there is room for. Your child makes a short row of steps and uses the again button, which shows how many times as dots, to have the robot do them over. None of these can be done without it.

lessons.title: Find the step that went wrong
lessons.summary: A row of steps is already there, and one of them is wrong. The robot runs it and your child sees where it goes astray, takes out the one wrong step and puts the right one in. Finding the step is the point: one change mends each of these.
